_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: RBL Bank IndianOil XTRA Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: XTRA T&C 4.2 and FAQ 11, 26: 1 Fuel Point = ₹0.50 when converted to IndianOil XTRA Reward points (3 Fuel Points = 5 XRP, 1 XRP = ₹0.30) for fuel at IndianOil stations, and ₹0.10 on the RBL Rewards Portal. The baseline is the ₹0.10 value available everywhere; ₹0.50 applies only to conversion for fuel at IndianOil stations, which is what the page headlines ("8.5% valueback").

components: Total GST + current-month EMI debits + [the higher of (100% of fees and charges + 5% of retail spends, cash advance and interest) or ₹200] + any unpaid earlier minimum due + over-limit utilisation (MITC section D-b)
If that amount exceeds the total amount due, the minimum due equals the total amount due

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Annual fee of ₹1,500 + GST is waived on valid spends of ₹2.75 lakh a year (XTRA T&C 3.3; SOC; MITC); the waiver applies only if the annual fee has been paid (page). Excluded categories do not count; Fuel & Auto is not excluded.

At ₹0.50 (XRP conversion) that is ₹1,500; at ₹0.10 it is ₹300, so no rupee value is stored.

open_questions: Network: the page says Mastercard and RuPay; which a given customer gets is not stated. Stored as a dual-network card with network left null. is_upi_linkable is true for the RuPay variant only (T&C 3.6); the Mastercard variant cannot be linked to UPI (MITC section C).
Cap period: the T&C and FAQ say "2,000 fuel points in a month" without defining the month; points are credited "once bill has been generated". Modelled as statement_cycle.

What earns above the 2,000-point cap at IndianOil stations is not stated: T&C 3.2 gives the 2-point base rate for purchases "other than excluded categories and IndianOil fuel stations", while FAQ 2 says 2 points on "all spends except the exclusion categories (no capping)". Modelled as falling back to 2 points per ₹100.

Value of a Fuel Point: ₹0.50 through XTRA Reward conversion (3 Fuel Points = 5 XRP at ₹0.30 each) and ₹0.10 elsewhere. The baseline is ₹0.10, so the stored base return is 0.2% and the IndianOil rate 1.5%; at ₹0.50 they are 1% and 7.5% (the page headlines 8.5% including the 1% surcharge waiver).
The "250 litres free petrol a year on monthly spends of ₹45,000" headline was not reconciled with the earn rate and is not modelled.

Redemption fee for XRP conversion: MITC and RWD say "IOCL Credit Card - RBL Rewards Conversion >5000 (Fee Waived)"; what the 5,000 refers to is not stated, so redemption_fee_inr is null for that route.
IndianOil station list: accelerated points apply only at the MID/TID list IOCL supplies (cc-iocl-fuel-station-list.pdf), which was not read.
Fuel surcharge waiver is processed on the 23rd of each month; whether the ₹200 cap is per calendar month or per statement is not stated beyond "every month".
Welcome and annual-fee-waiver conditions require the annual fee to be paid; the "valid spends" for the ₹2.75 lakh waiver exclude the same categories as the earn rate.

Finance charge: MITC says "up to 3.99% per month (47.88% a year)" for these cards and then lists bureau-score bands (above 775: 3.35% a month; 725-775: 3.85%; below 725: 3.99%). The draft stores the 3.99% maximum.
notes: Rewards are "Fuel Points"; they are valid for 2 years from earning (FAQ 12) and cannot be adjusted against the card outstanding (FAQ 19).
Fuel Points convert to IndianOil XTRA Reward points only on the RBL Rewards Portal (FAQ 26).
Fuel & Auto is not an excluded earn category on this card; the SOC and MITC 1% fee on fuel transactions above ₹10,000 (max ₹3,000) still applies.
Joining fee is NIL (MITC); the first-year fee is stored as the annual fee.
